violated_contract: A reduced-traffic provider recovery trial must not re-bench from a tiny failure-share sample or a weaker rejection rule than the full-traffic burst detector.
canonical_prevention: Use the shared gate transition for every target: require at least 100 admitted non-censored trial outcomes and the full-traffic burst evidence before rejection, retain witness fairness and promotion, and cover tiny samples, separated failures, real bursts, and censored observations with behavioral replays.
